topics.description: Minnesota lawmakers are rushing to create a new fraud-fighting agency to combat Medicaid fraud, which has been a significant issue in the state. The agency will focus on investigating and preventing fraud in the Medicaid program.
topics.reason: Recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases
